'''Davit Berek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pamorjal]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Berek became a member of the [[Pamorjal Freeman's League]], a resistance group that opposed the actions of mega-corporations on Pamorjal. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]] traveled to Pamorjal while being pursued by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents, an he convinced the PFL that the agents were in fact representatives of [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]]. Berek led a PFL assault team in an attack on the agents outside the [[Temples of Vormijj]], but eventually realized that Rystra had tricked the League. Feeling guilty, because the PFL had destroyed the agents' [[Starship/Legends|starship]], Berek gave them the ''[[Celestial Dancer]]'', a [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] that was owned by the League.
